teaching.title: Programming Teaching Assistant
bullets: Answered student questions about debugging and loops during assigned office hours sessions.
Graded programming exercises using an instructor-provided rubric and prepared worked examples for instructor review.

projects.title: Calculator Module Testing
bullets: Wrote automated tests for a small calculator module using C++ and Git as a team project contributor.
Designed boundary and invalid-input test cases, and documented expected behaviour and regression checks for the calculator module.

projects.title: Set Operation Explorer
bullets: Translated discrete mathematical definitions into C++ program functions for an individual set operation explorer project.
Explained the connection between formal definitions and implementation, and tested the implementation against hand-worked cases.

projects.title: Recipe Organiser
bullets: Implemented a menu-driven recipe organiser in C++ using functions and collections for an individual course project.
Tested representative inputs, recorded expected outputs, and documented how recipe records are added, searched and updated.
